name: thaliyo
description: Repo root: run scripts for every app from here. Each app keeps its own node_modules.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/business-panel && npm ci --prefix apps/super-admin && npm ci --prefix apps/staff && npm ci --prefix apps/customer && npm ci --prefix apps/delivery && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix apps/business-panel && npm run build --prefix apps/super-admin && npm run build --prefix apps/staff && npm run build --prefix apps/marketing-site && npm run build --prefix apps/customer && npm run build --prefix apps/delivery && npm run build --prefix backend
